ownership_decision.invariant: Publishing alone decides which skills are exposed; catalog shows a skill outside the catalog only when publishing reports it exposed at that version and digest.

boundary_decision.interaction: Unchanged: catalog reads exposure from publishing through the composition-root fact reader; the reader now takes an optional skill.

domain_forces: A detail request read the exposure state of every publication to answer for one skill.
implementation_design.decision: Give the exposure state read an optional skill filter on the existing unique index and let detail pass its own skill; re-cite the interaction whose cited line changed.
invariants_preserved: The record states the same collaboration as before.
Search and browse still read the full exposed set.
rejected_alternatives: Caching the exposed set: it would delay withdrawing exposure.
implementation_design.counterfactual_check: Drop the skill filter from the state query; TestExposureStatesNarrowedToASkillReadOnlyThatSkill must fail.

approvals.scope: Re-cite the publishing-to-catalog exposure interaction after ExposedSkills gained an optional skill filter; the collaboration is unchanged
